intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Strix G16 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to high GPU usage during intense gaming and multitasking
suggested_solution: Ensure system is running on clean and optimized Windows installation, update NVIDIA GeForce Driver to latest version (528.80), update ASUS ROG Strix G16 BIOS to V2.02, keep laptop in well-ventilated area or use cooling pad, monitor system temperatures and adjust usage patterns
